The overall procedure is summarized in Algorithm 1 . At each stage, we project the parameters onto one of the orthogonal subspaces, apply noisy fine-tuning without model clipping restricted to this subspace, and finally run several standard fine-tuning steps on the full model. At each sequential step, noise is injected only into a single block of dimension r i r_{i} (rather than all d d parameters).
